title: God with Us This Christmas
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he dives into the true meaning of Christmas, exploring the profound truth that God is with us, and how that changes everything. In this inspiring message, Pastor Chris will help you understand the significance of Jesus' birth and how it impacts your life today, giving you the confidence to face any obstacle with faith and assurance. Don't miss this powerful reminder of God's presence and love for you.
